import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.r.mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w); print(e); print(g)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); bs=[]
for i in range(1000):
    d=w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))
    bs.append(est(d)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for col in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']: print(pd.crosstab(w[col],w.late,normalize='columns').round(3))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','ap']].mean())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc])[0])
m=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+n_editions+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3))
print(w[(w[c]>0)&(w.date_confidence=='high')].sample(6,random_state=1)[['work_id','year']])
